prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Projected across the whole scene, coloured oil and water swim like a liquid light show: huge soft-edged blobs of amber, magenta and cobalt blue drift over the faces, clothes and walls, merging and splitting, with thin dark rims where oil meets water. Camera at the height of the felt, the white cue ball huge and sharp in the foreground. In a smoky underground pool hall, an old gangster with a white moustache and rolled sleeves leans over the table lining up a shot, a young gangster with slicked red hair and freckles watching, a band in pinstripe suits playing on a small stage behind them. Light: a row of green-shaded lamps low over the tables; the band's stage lit red; deep shadow everywhere else. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
